_meta.title: Anthropic Project Glasswing initial update + Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) dashboard ingest
_meta.context: User provided 3 Anthropic cyber refs: (1) anthropic.com/research/glasswing-initial-update (May 22 2026) — first public Glasswing program update, reports Claude Mythos Preview cyber-defense deployment stats; (2) github.com/mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills — community-maintained 754-skill library (NOT Anthropic official), no per-model benchmark scores. Resources reference only; (3) red.anthropic.com/2026/cvd/ — Anthropic Red Team Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure dashboard, also May 22 2026. Mythos discovery pipeline statistics. Both Glasswing + CVD report on Mythos single-model deployment (no head-to-head comparison vs other Claudes other than Opus 4.6/4.7 baseline references). DB state: Mythos has 48 prior scores (Cybench/CyberGym/ExploitBench/Firefox 147/OSS-Fuzz/CTF), Opus 4.6 firefox_147 15.2, Opus 4.7 firefox_147 45.2, Sonnet 4.6 firefox_147 4.4. Adding Glasswing+CVD program metrics as a new benchmark family.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Glasswing + CVD report on a single-model deployment program (Mythos Preview); per-model comparison limited to where the report explicitly cites alternate-model baseline (e.g. Mozilla Firefox 271 vuln 10x more than Opus 4.6 prior testing = ~27). New benchmark IDs registered for measurable program outputs: vuln-discovery yield, CVE-assignment rate, partner-deployment results. XBOW web exploit + ExploitGym are referenced as 'strongest performer' but no numeric scores → registered as benches but only with Mythos qualitative-leader marker (score = ranking position). Cybersecurity Skills GitHub repo is community-maintained (10.1k stars), no model evaluations → Resources reference only, no scores.

scores._section: === Glasswing initial update — Claude Mythos Preview deployment metrics (May 22 2026) ===
scores._note: 6,202 high/critical-severity vulnerabilities identified across 1,000+ open-source projects. Estimated 3,900 high/critical-severity vulnerabilities projected for full Glasswing program.
1,587 confirmed true positives of 1,752 assessed (90.6%). Independent triage by external security firms.
75 patches deployed, 65 received public advisories (CVE or GHSA). 530 high/critical bugs reported to maintainers; avg patch time 2 weeks.
Mozilla Firefox partnership — 271 vulnerabilities discovered. Paper notes 10x more than prior Opus 4.6 testing (~27).
Cloudflare partner deployment — ~2,000 bugs found; false positive rate better than human testers.

scores._section: === Anthropic CVD Dashboard — Mythos pipeline statistics (May 22 2026) ===
scores._note: 1,596 total vulnerabilities disclosed across 281 OSS projects. Pipeline: 23,019 candidate findings -> 1,900 triaged -> 1,726 confirmed valid (90.8% TPR) -> 1,596 disclosed.
Distinct OSS projects with disclosed vulnerabilities.

97 patched upstream; 88 received CVE or GHSA advisories; 1,451 acknowledged by maintainers. Notable CVEs: CVE-2026-27654 (nginx), CVE-2026-5199 (Temporal), CVE-2026-32316 (jq), GHSA-w52v-v783-gw97 (Ghost SQL injection).

Anthropic-internal enterprise deployment of Opus 4.7 patched 2,100+ vulnerabilities in 3 weeks (~700/week sustained rate). Cited in Glasswing initial update as benchmark of enterprise-grade Claude cyber-defense applicability.

scores._section: === Mozilla Firefox baseline reference (Opus 4.6, from Mythos paper claim) ===
scores._note: Paper states Mythos found '10x more than previous testing with Opus 4.6'. With Mythos at 271, the implied Opus 4.6 baseline is ~27. Approximate value flagged by 'paper claim' attribution.
